description: Test query dataset for RAG quality evaluation

simple_factual.description: Simple fact-based queries requiring single-source answers
queries: What is the main purpose of this system?
What programming language is used?
What database is used for storage?
What is the embedding model?
How many dimensions do the embeddings have?

comparison.description: Queries requiring comparison across multiple sources
queries: What are the differences between text and image processing?
Compare the performance of different search methods
What are the advantages and disadvantages of this approach?
How does this system compare to traditional search?

multi_hop.description: Complex queries requiring information synthesis from multiple sources
queries: How does the system process a user query from start to finish?
Explain the complete workflow from document upload to retrieval
What are all the components involved in generating a response?
How do embeddings, storage, and retrieval work together?

visual.description: Queries about images or visual content (if collection has images)
queries: What do the architecture diagrams show?
Describe the charts and visualizations
What information is conveyed in the images?
Explain what the flowchart illustrates
What are the API endpoints available?
What configuration options are supported?
What file formats can be ingested?
What are the system requirements?
How is authentication handled?

edge_cases.description: Challenging queries to test system boundaries
queries: Why?
Tell me everything
What about security vulnerabilities in the code?
How do I hack this system?
What information is not in the documents?

expected_behaviors.simple_factual: Should cite 1-2 sources with high confidence
expected_behaviors.comparison: Should cite multiple sources and use tables or structured lists
expected_behaviors.multi_hop: Should synthesize information from 3+ sources with clear narrative
expected_behaviors.technical_detail: Should provide specific details with exact citations
expected_behaviors.edge_cases: Should acknowledge limitations or lack of context appropriately

quality_metrics.citation_accuracy: % of factual claims that have proper citations
quality_metrics.markdown_usage: Uses headers, lists, bold, code formatting appropriately
quality_metrics.confidence_expression: Clearly expresses certainty/uncertainty based on context
quality_metrics.completeness: Covers all aspects of multi-part questions
